title: Show empty scan outcome on Dashboard Pipeline tile
summary: Adds a WebView-only Dashboard Pipeline tile state that reports No New Sources after loaded backend queue evidence proves a source scan or launch found zero runnable queue rows.
reason: After launching or scanning, operators need a clear idle outcome when all configured sources were checked but no new runnable work exists.
behavior_before: The Dashboard Pipeline tile returned to generic Idle/Completed-style state after an empty scan, even when the queue payload proved there were no runnable rows.
behavior_after: The Dashboard Pipeline tile renders No New Sources when fresh backend queue evidence shows zero runnable rows and no active, running, stale, warning, or error state needs to remain visible.
tests_added: Extended tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static.py to pin the No New Sources tile label and refreshAllNow queue-outcome hook.

Extended tests/webview/test_webview_browser_home_live_state_smoke.py with a fresh empty queue payload that proves No New Sources renders, active snapshot states are preserved, queue-count is unchanged, and no mutation POST route is called.
